label: verify-bm-biopolymer-films

claims.claim: Cast silk fibroin films strain 5.0 to 7.3 percent in length between 10 and 90 percent RH, far above the 0.2 to 1 percent of stock resins.
claims.note: Silk figures reproduce exactly (WR strain defined over 10 to 90% RH); the 7.29% value is for porous 60% PEO films, and the 0.2 to 1% resin figure is the agent's own estimate, not from this source.

claims.claim: 8 um silk on 25 um polyimide gives a 13 to 21 cm^-1 curvature change and bends in 13 to 44 s; only polyimide has been tested as backing.
claims.source_says: depositing an 8 µm thick layer of RSF onto 3x4x0.025 mm polyimide films; This difference increased from 13 cm-1 to 21 cm-1; bilayer films took similar time to bend within 13–44 seconds and straighten within 22–40 seconds
claims.note: Each number is in the sources, but 13 to 21 comes from the 2025 paper (rising with tyrosine modification) and 13 to 44 s from the 2023 porous-silk paper, so they are not one measurement; the no-other-backing point is an absence claim.

claims.claim: Cellulose is not a large-strain material: NFC swelling about 0.06 to 0.09 percent, CNC isotropic coefficient 0.040 percent per percent moisture, only shear-aligned CNC across alignment (0.30) approaches wood-like values.
claims.source_says: swelling ratio of the 8-µm NFC film is estimated to be only about 0.06%; ... 48-µm film ... about 0.09%. Self-organized CNC films ... CHS ∼0.040 %strain/%C ... shear-oriented ... ∼0.02 and ∼0.30
claims.note: Both sources confirmed (Aalto PDF and Europe PMC abstract); the wood comparison value (beech 0.32) comes from the project record, not these sources.

claims.claim: Stock Formlabs resins' under-1-percent water gain holds for the 1 cm cube table but not for Flexible 80A Resin V2 on its data sheet (ASTM D471: +8 percent mass, +3 percent volume in 1 day).
claims.source_says: Cube table: Flexible 80A Resin water 0.7. Data sheet water row sits between rows '1 day -26 +8% +3%' and '1 week -27 +9% +7%' (label at y=401, rows at y=396 and 406).
claims.note: Reproduced with word coordinates: the Deionized Water label lies between the two rows, so the 1-day and 1-week assignment is inferred from the layout, but the figures are on the Flexible 80A V2 data sheet.

overall: All four key claims check out against the originals. The two weaker points are the bilayer claim, which merges numbers from two different papers, and the Flexible 80A V2 water row, whose label position is ambiguous in the PDF layout. The 0.2 to 1 percent resin comparison is the agent's own estimate.
